daily_rules: Previous completed session only; min price Rs50; prior average turnover Rs10cr; 0.5-6% ATR/price. Max 5 positions, 2 per current industry, 20% notional/name, 0.5% risk/name, no leverage. Swing enters every hold-length sessions, initial 2ATR stop, no profit target, close on holding limit. Intraday enters next open; 1ATR stop, 1.5ATR target, close same session. Stop-first ambiguous bars.
costs: Swing per side 0.15% fee/tax scenario + 0.05% slippage. Intraday per side 0.05% fee/tax scenario + 0.05% slippage. Double both for stress. Fees not verified broker tariffs.
orb_candidate: 5-minute opening-range direction, relative first-bar volume >=1.5 against prior 20 valid openings; top five. Stop opposite opening-range edge. Earliest entry next bar, order cancels after 11:00 IST, time exit 15:10 bar close. No profit target. No leverage. Same intraday cost/risk caps. No same-bar ordering advantage.
validation_gate: No live winner. Exploratory candidate only if each of 3 periods positive, recent doubled-cost positive, recent >=30 closed trades and >=252 benchmark sessions. All results disclosed, including failures.
limitations: Current constituent survivors; fixed current industry labels; no historical intraday short eligibility or circuit-state ledger. Recent minute data only gives a smoke test. Futures/options need actual contracts, expiry, bid/ask, historical lot sizes, margin and fees. Spot-derived option P&L is prohibited.
